By putting Precious Metal Solution through the Chemical Reactor again, it will produce Ferric Metal Sludge, Nitrogen Dioxide, and §aChloroauric Acid
§fSome notes: The Nitrogen Dioxide enables a perfect loop, and no Nitrogen is consumed in the production of Chloroauric Acid. Oxygen and Hydrogen are consumed in the production of the Nitric Acid though. Ferric Metal Sludge is a waste product, later you may be able to recoup a decent amount of iron from it, however for right now you have an Arc Furnace recipe with pretty poor return.
